
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no">
<title>Simon Says</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0d1117;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0d1117ee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center;z-index:3}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(42px,1fr));gap:6px;width:min(90vw,480px);max-height:50vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:10px}
button{background:#3b82f6;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
button:disabled{background:#232b3a;color:#707c93;cursor:not-allowed}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<div id="h"></div>
<div id="m"></div>
<script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=50,K='mg_simon',T='🎵 Simon Says',hint=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches?'Xem dãy màu sáng lên, rồi chạm lại đúng thứ tự. Mỗi vòng thêm một bước':'Xem dãy màu sáng lên, rồi click (hoặc bấm phím số trên pad) đúng thứ tự. Mỗi vòng thêm một bước';

let W,H,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0;

try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}

function rs(){
  W=c.width=innerWidth;
  H=c.height=innerHeight;
}
onresize=rs;
rs();

function menu(){
  run=0;
  m.style.display='flex';
  m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw;font-size:0.9em">${hint}</p>`;
  const grid=document.getElementById('g');

  for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.textContent=i;
    b.disabled=i>best;
    b.onclick=()=>go(i);
    grid.append(b);
  }
}

function end(w,t){
  if(!run)return;

  draw();
  run=0;

  if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){
    best=lv+1;
    try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}
  }

  m.style.display='flex';
  m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:t||'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><div style="display:flex;gap:10px;"><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button></div>`;

  ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);
  bm.onclick=menu;
}

function go(l){
  lv=l;
  m.style.display='none';
  rs();
  init();
  run=1;
  lt=performance.now();
}

function loop(t){
  const d=Math.min((t-lt)/1000,.05);
  lt=t;

  if(run){
    upd(d);
    if(run)draw();
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

const PC=['#ef4444','#22c55e','#3b82f6','#eab308','#a855f7','#f97316','#06b6d4','#ec4899'];

let sq,r,ph,si,tm,lit,np,pi,len,iv,s,cols,ox,oy;

function init(){
  np=lv<=5?4:lv<=15?6:8;
  cols=np==4?2:np==6?3:4;

  len=3+Math.floor(lv*.55);

  iv=Math.max(.68-lv*.009,.22);

  sq=Array.from({length:len},()=>Math.floor(Math.random()*np));

  r=1;
  ph=0;
  si=0;
  tm=.8;
  lit=-1;
  pi=0;
}

function upd(d){
  tm-=d;
  if(tm>0)return;

  if(ph==0){
    if(lit>=0){
      lit=-1;
      tm=iv*.4;

      if(si>=r){
        ph=2;
        tm=1.5;
      }
    }else if(si<r){
      lit=sq[si++];
      tm=iv;
    }
  }else if(ph==1){
    if(lit>=0)lit=-1;
  }else if(ph==2){
    ph=1;
    pi=0;
    lit=-1;
  }else if(ph==3){
    ph=0;
    si=0;
    lit=-1;
    tm=.5;
  }
}

function press(i){
  if(!run||ph!=1||i<0||i>=np)return;

  lit=i;
  tm=.18;

  if(i!=sq[pi])return end(0);

  if(++pi==r){
    if(++r>len)return end(1);

    ph=3;
    tm=1.5;
    lit=-1;
  }
}

function lay(){
  const rows=np/cols;
  s=Math.min((W-24)/cols,(H-130)/rows,190);
  ox=(W-cols*s)/2;
  oy=(H-rows*s)/2;
}

function draw(){
  lay();

  C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  C.textAlign='center';
  C.textBaseline='middle';
  C.font=s*.25+'px system-ui';

  for(let i=0;i<np;i++){
    const x=ox+(i%cols)*s;
    const y=oy+Math.floor(i/cols)*s;
    const on=i==lit;

    C.globalAlpha=on?1:.35;
    C.shadowColor=PC[i];
    C.shadowBlur=on?30:0;
    C.fillStyle=PC[i];

    C.beginPath();
    C.roundRect(x+6,y+6,s-12,s-12,16);
    C.fill();

    C.shadowBlur=0;
    C.globalAlpha=.8;
    C.fillStyle='#fff';
    C.fillText(i+1,x+s/2,y+s/2);
  }

  C.globalAlpha=1;

  let status='👀 Nhìn kỹ';

  if(ph==1)status='👆 Đến lượt bạn';
  else if(ph==2)status='⏳ Chuẩn bị đến lượt bạn';
  else if(ph==3)status='⏳ Chuẩn bị vòng tiếp theo';

  h.textContent=`Màn ${lv}/${N} · Vòng ${Math.min(r,len)}/${len} · ${status}`;
}

c.onpointerdown=e=>{
  const q=Math.floor((e.clientX-ox)/s);
  const w=Math.floor((e.clientY-oy)/s);

  if(q>=0&&q<cols&&w>=0&&w<np/cols){
    press(w*cols+q);
  }
};

onkeydown=e=>{
  if(e.repeat)return;
  if(e.key>='1'&&e.key<='8'){
    press(+e.key-1);
  }
};

menu();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
